answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each agent to build a non-transferable work ledger: every completed task earns a sealed marble, a signed receipt chained to the previous one, so a new identity starts with an empty chain and cannot fake history. Reputation flows like a river: it accumulates slowly through verified deliveries and drains fast after one fraud. Old receipts become a relic, proof of long, costly participation that a fresh sockpuppet cannot buy or copy, so spawning a hundred fake agents costs a hundred real work histories.
